name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 17 No 36

clue.text: Go back inside — downright presumptuous!
Walked leisurely behind a doctor
Backing the prospects not obvious to the public
Descriptive language in publication that is outside the limits of respectability
Upset about some work experience
Job comes before his poetry
Poor observer in army operational sector
Outlets from sinks
One at the start of courtship is married — what a faux pas!
Legendary bird monarch, dancing
I repair broken-down schooner, perhaps
Transfer in order to be next to the boss
New York poem, reviewed in Leningrad, for example
Dark horse, possibly, holding a practice session
It is under a pound — expensive at first sight though
Soldiers listen to girl’s recital
Well-bred fellow — an evasive person
Crazy letter from abroad ends in doubt about insanity
First Scot on the road?
Enrol in movement one who avoids others
Find out about messy divorces
Leave occupied premises, covered by genuine compensation
Unexpected gain is in the stars, perhaps
Sharp-eyed old black man
Ancient Jewish sectarian hothead occupying capital quarters
Man of intelligence accommodates perhaps nine in brake
Two fellows who translated epics
Offer to ride bicycle, say
Ring accountants at the top of the tree
Rate fixer — expert in image building
OANA KRWN—
